@@U03355@@
Who knows, maybe Paradise was like this. We're just glad to be here, and thank our lucky stars for it. East or west, Mother Earth is forever fruitful.

@@U03357@@
If Earth Mother in a single night Could bring these little ones to light, Then She the littlest can create, And each of us will find a mate.

@@U03359@@
Hurry! Make haste! See you're properly placed! With speed as our muscle, Let’s hustle and bustle! While peace still holds steady Make our foundries ready, Weapons with speed The army will need. Ants, gather near, We ask of you here Bring metal, bring ore! And dactyls so many You smallest of any, Do us all good, Fetch us much wood! Pile it up high, High as the sky, Of coals we need more!

@@U03361@@
With arrow and bow March out to the foe! Shoot me those herons Down there by the marsh, Clustering numberless, Croaking so harsh, Puffing and preening,
translation:
@@U03355@@
谁知道呢，也许天堂就是这样的。我们很高兴来到这里，并为此感谢我们的幸运星。无论东方还是西方，地球母亲永远硕果累累。

@@U03357@@
如果地球母亲在一夜之内就能将这些小生命带入光明，那么她最小的就能创造，我们每个人都会找到一个伴侣。

@@U03359@@
快点！赶快！看看你的位置是否正确！以速度为肌肉，让我们忙碌起来！在和平仍然稳定的情况下，让我们的铸造厂做好准备，军队将需要快速武器。蚂蚁们，聚集过来，我们请你们带上金属，带上矿石！还有这么多的指节，你是最小的，对我们都好，给我们拿很多木头！把它堆得高高的，像天一样高，我们需要更多的煤炭！

@@U03361@@
带着箭和弓向敌人进军！向我射那些苍鹭在沼泽边，聚集了无数，呱呱叫得那么刺耳，气喘吁吁，梳理羽毛，
